  | x :: xs => x + total xs

theorem insertN_total (x : Nat) (ys : List Nat) :
    total (insertN x ys) = x + total ys := by
  induction ys with
  | nil => simp [insertN, total]
  | cons y ys ih =>
      by_cases h : x ≤ y
      · simp [insertN, total, h]
      · simp [insertN, total, h, ih, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_left_comm, Nat.add_comm]

theorem insertionSort_sum (xs : List Nat) : total (insertionSort xs) = total xs := by
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
      simp [insertionSort, insertN_total, ih, total]

  | [] => [x]
  | y :: ys => if x ≤ y then x :: y :: ys else y :: insertN x ys

theorem insertionSort_sum (xs : List Nat) : total (insertionSort xs) = total xs := by
  have hinsert : ∀ x ys, total (insertN x ys) = x + total ys := by
    intro x ys
    induction ys with
    | nil => simp [insertN, total]
    | cons y ys ih =>
      simp only [insertN]
      split
      · simp [total]
      · simp only [total]
        rw [ih]
        omega
  induction xs with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons x xs ih =>
    simp [insertionSort, total, hinsert, ih]

    induction e with
